definitions.gloss: anaerobic; able to live without oxygen
definitions.explanation: The property of being able to live or function without oxygen. Used especially of bacteria and other microorganisms.

examples.japanese: {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}の{細菌|さいきん}がいる。
この{菌|きん}は{嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}で、{酸素|さんそ}のない{環境|かんきょう}を{好|この}む。
examples.english: This microbe is anaerobic and prefers environments without oxygen.

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ごみを{嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}{発酵|はっこう}させると、メタンガスが{発生|はっせい}する。
examples.english: Fermenting food waste anaerobically produces methane gas.

notes:
Composed of {嫌気|けんき} (disliking air or oxygen) + {性|せい} (-ness, property). A biology and environmental-science term. Often used attributively with の: {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}の{細菌|さいきん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}{細菌|さいきん}: anaerobic bacteria
- {嫌気|けんき}{性|せい}{発酵|はっこう}: anaerobic fermentation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {好気|こうき}{性|せい}: aerobic — the antonym; describes organisms that require oxygen to live
